question: Propose the most cost-effective measurable leading indicator for the stated failure, its operating threshold, and the concrete test that would validate or kill the predictor.
pipeline_answer:
Data-driven fault detection and diagnosis leveraging labeled historical operational data to identify fault symptoms for transfer learning applications.

Implement a time-series regression model on existing BAS logs that correlates the "pre-filter pressure slope" against the "final-filter alarm" history to predict remaining useful life, utilizing the identified 15% drop pattern as a precursor feature.

The system will trigger a predictive maintenance alert 72 hours before observable quality degradation, reducing false alarms to under 3 per year by leveraging the specific pre-filter slope drop indicator found in the historical data.

Run a backtest on 3 years of historical data (n=42 AHU-years) where the alert fires if the pre-filter pressure slope drops by 15% over 7 days; verify that alerts occur ≥72 hours before final filter alarms and count annual false positives to ensure ≤3.
